Creates a state space tree to explore all possible branches using depth-first search (DFS). The algorithm follows a recursive approach, exploring each branch until a termination condition is met, and then backtracking to explore other branches.

The function terminates the branching of a node when the sum of the current path exceeds the `max_sum` or when the sum of the current path plus the remaining numbers in `nums` is less than `max_sum`. It also terminates the branching when the sum of the current path equals `max_sum`, at which point the current path is added to the `result` list.

The algorithm backtracks when the current node is not branchable, ensuring that all possible paths are explored.
